mustFix.problem: All 8 image slots are placeholders (hatched gradients) with alt text 'Placeholder for ...'; the page shows no pool, water or equipment anywhere
mustFix.fix: Curate real approved frames into niches/pool/media (clear water surface hero, test vials, salt cell, filter cartridge, equipment pad, clear water after, Orlando street) and re-place them with [[img]] so manifest alt text describes each frame

elevate.move: Fold photography into the gauge system: each story photo gets its test-pad colour edge and a reading overlay in the report's type (e.g. 'Filter 18 psi, ideal 10-20'), and the full-bleed water break becomes the 'after' of the hero reading, so reading, work and clear water read as one sequence

Make 'the numbers settle into their ideal bands' the one motion idea: each #story card's entry drives its gauge marker from out-of-range into the shaded band and fills the matching 'logged' row; the hero report runs the same settle once under 1.2 s and the footer pads fill left to right
